The '''Taris asteroid belt''' was located in the [[Taris system/Legends|Taris system]]. It contained a number of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Taris (star)|sun]], including the [[Rogue Moon]] which orbited in the opposite direction to the rest.

==History==
The asteroid belt was the site of the final test of the five [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] training at the [[Jedi Tower]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. It was later used by [[Zayne Carrick]] to hide for a time after his initial escape from the planet.
